transcript: Did you know finger scraping is good for the lungs? Scrape the thumb to support the lungs, especially with a sore throat, chest tightness, or shortness of breath. Scrape the index finger for bloating or irregular digestion. The middle finger may help calm a busy mind and support restful sleep. The ring finger is traditionally used for headaches, migraines, and shoulder tension. Scraping the little finger may help soothe anxiety, a racing heartbeat, or chest discomfort. Monks in our monastery have practiced this for generations. Want more practical ways to support your well-being? Get my book, Time to Heal, for more traditional medicine cures.
